{{Quote|I saw my father killed, and I will avenge his death.|Quintama, in a hologram message|<ref name="JA" />}}
A [[Gender/Legends|male]] member of the [[Melida/Legends|Melida]] people of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Melida/Daan/Legends|Melida/Daan]] was the '''father''' of [[Quintama]], who would eventually become a [[Captain/Legends|captain]] in the [[Melida Liberation Force]]. He also became the grandfather of Quintama's children, [[Wunana]] and [[Renei]]. During the Melida's [[Standard century|centuries]] long conflict with the [[Daan (people)/Legends|Daan]] people, Quintama witnessed the Daan [[Death/Legends|kill]] his [[Parent/Legends|father]].<ref name="JA" /> By [[52 BBY/Legends|52 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> prior to the [[Twenty-First Battle of Zehava]], in which Quintama would be killed, he recorded a [[Hologram/Legends|hologram]] message vowing to avenge his father and others killed by the Daan.<ref name="JA" /> In [[44 BBY/Legends|44 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] and [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] viewed Quintama's message mentioning his father, which was kept in a [[Hall of Evidence]] mausoleum.<ref name="JA" />

==Behind the scenes==
Quintama's father was mentioned in ''[[Jedi Apprentice: The Defenders of the Dead]]'', a [[1999]] young-readers novel written by [[Jude Watson]] as the fifth entry in the ''[[Star Wars: Jedi Apprentice]]'' series.<ref name="JA" />
